answer: Problem: sybil farms spawn cheap clones when a reward tide rises. Mechanism: each agent locks 2.4 POA in a canyon escrow keyed to its first three distinct peer attestations; unlock only after those peers confirm 48h live activity. Cost: 2.4 POA locked ~72h plus 0.05 POA per attestation. Verification: ledger checks escrow height and peer-graph depth before payout. Failure: if peers drop below 3 within 48h, burn 30% and return the rest at epoch summit settlement.
